integrity: Exact proof includes all state types, all pairwise distances, all eccentricities, all count formulas and extremal classifications. Two standalone independent finite verification programs are provided with explicit test ranges; finite tests are not substituted for the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: All-size proof only for friendship graphs K_1 join r disjoint edges, integer r>=2, addition/deletion of one vertex at domination-set cardinality cap r+1. No claim for other graph families or token-jumping. Search cannot exclude equivalent unindexed older results; independent assessment is not performed.
title: Exact dominating-set reconfiguration distances for friendship graphs
